title: Office of the pool
caption: platform.amadeus_offices.status; assigned and releasing always carry assigned_tenant_id (amadeus_offices_assignment_ck). Code: (app)/amadeus/offices/*.

states.label: assigned
states.detail: Backs the OTA's `velexis` connection. **Release** only while that connection is not active (else `409 connection_active`).

states.label: releasing
states.detail: The OTA moved to its own credentials and keeps the office for old orders (`release_requested_at`). **Release** with the 'no open bookings' box and a reason.

states.label: retired
states.detail: Never assigned again; no buttons but notes.
